description: A soldier walks across an empty field at dawn, long shot with heavy morning mist.

spec.subject: A lone adult soldier, average height and build, wearing a dark olive drab field uniform, mud-stained combat boots, a web belt, and a steel helmet; no visible insignia, a rifle slung low across the back.
spec.setting: An empty open field at dawn, covered in heavy ground-level morning mist; short wet grass in the foreground, a flat pale field in the midground, and a barely visible horizon line fading into white fog in the background.
spec.action: The soldier walks steadily across the field from left to right, legs partially obscured by the mist.
spec.camera_angle: Long shot at eye level, soldier in the left third of frame with open misty space ahead
spec.lighting: Natural dawn light through heavy mist, low sun, haze filling the air
spec.style: Digital capture with fine grain, muted cool color grade, restrained contrast, naturalistic war-film realism with soft fog diffusion and subdued earth tones.
